newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not established on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers at a virtual standstill on Monday. Not enough sales either class to established a market. Buyer inquiry light to moderate, seller interest light.

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 66.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 66.00. Confirmed - 100 Last Week - 2,900 Last Year - Holiday
Wk To Date - 3,100 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 7,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 3,800
